issues.quote: lifting R&D expense to $27.2 million in fiscal 2023 from $24.5 billion in fiscal 2022
issues.problem: Unit error: Microsoft's FY2023 R&D expense was about $27.2 billion ($27,195 million), not $27.2 million.

data.summary: Revenue, gross profit, operating income, margins, net income and EPS figures are all correct. The only error is that fiscal 2023 R&D is stated as $27.2 million when it was about $27.2 billion.
